meta.name: ugc-fixloop
meta.description: the UGC fix-loop toolkit — surgically re-render a bad window/beat of a single-take UGC master (stitch_replacement.py, pure FFmpeg) and GPT cross-model review a Seedance prompt before render (vet_seedance_prompt.py, routed through the openai-proxy). Fetch it into a one-shot UGC recipe so both scripts resolve on any machine and the vet call bills the Ads agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 精准重渲染单条UGC视频的瑕疵片段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需修复单条UGC视频中的局部画面问题
copy.tagline_en: Surgically re-render a bad segment of a single-take UGC video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to fix local visual issues in single-take UGC videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你修复单次拍摄的 UGC 视频中某个片段：用 FFmpeg 替换视频的坏片段，保留原音频；还能在渲染前用 GPT 模型审查视频生成提示词。
howto.when: 当你需要修复一段 UGC 视频的某个片段，或想在渲染前让另一个 AI 模型审查提示词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用替换片段修复这个视频的第2个节拍。
审查这个 Seedance 提示词，给出修改建议。
say.note: Claude 会调用 GPT 模型审查提示词。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can surgically re-render a bad segment of a single-take UGC video: replace the video track of a specific window/beat using FFmpeg while keeping the original audio intact, and optionally review a Seedance prompt with a GPT model before rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to fix a specific segment of a UGC video, or when you want a second opinion on a Seedance prompt from a non-Claude model before rendering.

say_en.text: Replace beat 2 of this video with the replacement clip.
say_en.note: Claude runs stitch_replacement.py to swap the specified beat.

say_en.text: Review this Seedance prompt and suggest edits.
say_en.note: Claude calls GPT model to review the prompt.
